content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is a wall of text with three call actions (header Pokličite, Pokličite me, Pišite mi) and no visual anchor; the footer wordmark is oversized and the name repeats three times.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero leaves the whole left half under the headline empty, then runs into a dead band before pricing, while the footer wordmark is grotesquely large and overlaps the footer contents.","phone":{"impression":2,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"desktop":{"impression":2,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"fixes":["Add a portrait of Pia or a desk/notebook photo beside the hero text on desktop and under the headline on phone, so the empty left half and text wall get a visual anchor.","Shrink the giant footer wordmark to normal size and merge the name, address and contacts into one compact block instead of repeating the name three times.","Keep one primary action per screen: drop 'Pokličite me' in the hero and make 'Pišite mi' a proper button; tighten the dead bands after pricing and the about section."],"blockers":["Desktop footer: the oversized 'Inštrukcije Pia' wordmark is cut off at the slice edge and its descender overlaps the contact row.","Phone and desktop footer: the business name is repeated three times in succession (wordmark, bold name, Naziv line)."]}
